article.title: Why your sourdough doesn't rise
article.summary: A weak starter, cold dough or too little time: how to tell which one is flattening your bread, and what to change.
article.author: Mira Okafor
body: Most flat loaves come from a starter that isn't ready. Feed it, and use it when it has doubled and smells sour but not sharp.
Cold dough rises slowly. Below 22 °C, give the first rise an extra hour or two instead of adding yeast.
tips: Feed the starter twice the day before
Wait for it to grow by half
